fields.FIR_Description: The reported incident took place on 2026-06-12 (afternoon, 16:50): A message about KYC expiry led the complainant to a website where account credentials were entered, and Rs. 24,000 was transferred out. Amudha Sri submitted the complaint online using the mobile number 9000000218. Padmini Raj (9000000032) was mentioned as a person who was present nearby. An unidentified associate was also mentioned by the complainant. The complaint mentions Senthil Natarajan, who was reportedly contacted on 9000000262, in connection with the events. The complainant mentioned mobile phone records and social media screenshots. Records suggest a possible link with FIR-2026-00418, as the mobile number 9000000262 is associated with a suspect in both entries.
fields.Evidence_Mentioned: Mobile phone record; Social media screenshot
fields.Modus_Operandi: Victim reported receiving a suspicious link that imitated a bank notification.
fields.Keywords: phishing, suspicious link, phone records, apartment complex, witness, afternoon, screenshot, suspect
